runtimeResources.note: One loaded Brain, sequential real replies, process resident memory sampled after each reply relative to the pre-load process. Includes retained scratch and execution journals; not a within-call allocation peak.

metricDefinitions.tool: One proposed call with the exact expected name and complete argument map, without a veto; applicable labeled tool turns only.
metricDefinitions.completion: Exact call succeeds and its authoritative reply is not omitted by the display limit. Social relevance requires conversation review.
metricDefinitions.memory: Expected memory call plus resulting records, ownership, polarity, source evidence and recall content; applicable memory turns only.
metricDefinitions.repetition: Duplicate displayed responses divided by displayed turns. Includes legitimate repeated typed answers; free-response repetition is also reported.
metricDefinitions.latency: End-to-end Brain.Reply time, including packing, constrained decoding and tools; cold first replies are retained.
